purpose: Search only for biologically informative ITrace TCR-pMHC examples; no manuscript changes.
candidate_rule: Choose published biological comparisons before reading the new numeric rescreen. Include functional substitutions, engineered parent/variant relations, and same-receptor antigen changes; retain all listed series even if predictions are poor.
relationship_corrections_before_interpre: 7QPJ is from a different parent, not a second engineering step from7PDW. 7Q9B is MEL8, not MEL5. 6EQA/6EQB both contain AAG peptide and differ in TCR; 4QOK supplies native-decamer MEL5 comparison. Additional comparisons were nominated from primary biology, not from new model scores.
primary_model: Existing joint RMSF/chi-entropy Full family fold0, trained without any ITrace records; audit actual training manifests and checkpoint before relying on results.
secondary_control: Intrachain model from the same family fold0, not a replacement model selected for candidate success.
additional_existing_no_ITrace_model: Old strict full fold0, checkpoint SHA b3eed060919df15f075329bc892f959d9355232be5feb561417edd49ea82b39f. Include a parallel result on the same biologically nominated series; do not replace the primary model based on scores. Old strict train2431 differs from family train2430 by A00IL/4WV1, confirmed by actual per-record manifest set comparison. Earlier A009Z inference from an old review was incorrect and is superseded.
alignment: Full-chain global affine-gap alignment, inspect same receptor / engineered series correspondence and amino acid replacements. Never SequenceMatcher.
regions: same-amino-acid pMHC side of C-alpha8A interface
statistics: Use fixed complete regions; retain substitutions in backbone comparisons and report same-AA entropy separately. Do not treat residues or frames as independent MD replicates. No significance claims from abs(change)>2SEM.
publication_status: Exploratory example search only. No manuscript edits or delivery pointer updates.
